_comment: Polymarket tag -> internal category mapping (plan C4).
Matching is case-insensitive and exact on the normalized tag string.
A market is ACCEPTED if any of its tags maps to an allowed category and
NO tag appears in the blocklist. Blocklist wins over allowlist: a market
tagged both 'Politics' and 'Sports' is a sports market with a political
hook, and its resolution is driven by a game, not by the news flow the
agent's vaults actually cover.
This file is data, not code, so the taxonomy can be widened after seeing
what discovery actually returns without touching a module or redeploying.
Observed live 2026-07-25: Polymarket's tag vocabulary is a long tail of
thousands of free-form tags ('caitlin clark', 'ETF', 'Shenzhen') sitting
alongside a small set of canonical top-level ones. Only the canonical
ones are listed here; the long tail is ignored, which is why a market
must carry at least one recognised tag to qualify at all.
The broad 'crypto' tag is deliberately NOT blocked. The plan blocks pure
price markets, and the specific price tags below do that. Blocking the
whole domain would also veto a market tagged both 'Crypto' and
'Business' that is genuinely a financial question. A market carrying
only 'Crypto' is still rejected, because 'crypto' is not in the
allowlist either.
